projectPlan.purpose: To provide a simple, local-first tool for users to track their daily income and expenses with visual insights.
projectPlan.targetAudience: Individuals looking for a lightweight, private, and offline-capable finance management tool.
features: Dashboard with summary cards for total balance, income, and expenses
Full CRUD operations for transactions (Add, Edit, Delete)
Filter transactions by category or date range
Responsive modal-based forms for transaction management

pages.name: Dashboard
pages.description: Main view displaying summary metrics, charts, and the transaction list with search/filter controls.

components.name: TransactionModal
components.description: Reusable modal component for adding or editing transaction details.

components.name: TransactionTable
components.description: Dynamic table component to display filtered transaction data.

components.name: SummaryCards
components.description: Display components for high-level financial metrics.

fileStructure.purpose: Main application shell with containers for summary, charts, and transaction list.
Root composition file managing global state, event bus, and orchestrating UI updates.
Component to render balance, income, and expense metrics.
Component to render the list of transactions with search and filter logic.
Component to handle creation and editing of transactions via modal.
Component to render spending distribution charts using Chart.js.

responsibilities: Maintain global transaction state in LocalStorage
acceptanceCriteria: All UI components update when data changes

assertions: Data is saved to main state

# personal-finance-tracker

This is a generated frontend MVP built with Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS and Vite.

## Getting Started

1. Install dependencies:
   ```bash
   pnpm install
   ```
2. Run the development server:
   ```bash
   pnpm run dev
   ```

# Public API Keys (must be prefixed with VITE_)
VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
